title.zh: 整理是过程，产物才是你能用的东西
title.en: Organizing is the process; the output is what you use

m1a.zh: 周五前给客户回话：进度 / 风险 / 下周计划
m1a.en: Reply to the client by Friday: progress / risks / next week

m1c.zh: 评审结论：周报先模板化，智能化留给下个版本
m1c.en: Review call: ship the template-based report first, intelligence next release

m1e.zh: 竞品 App 上了语音转写，主打会议场景
m1e.en: A rival app shipped voice transcription for meeting use cases

1b.zh: 待办、会议纪要、竞品动态、用户需求、数据指标、用户故事、决策——七种常见卡片自动归位，随时可改写、可撤回。
1b.en: Todo, meeting notes, competitor news, user needs, metrics, user stories, decisions — seven everyday card types filed automatically, always editable and revocable.

m2b.en: Fold review conclusions into the report

2b.zh: 待办从记录里长出来，勾完就沉进历史，不用另开一个清单应用。
2b.en: Todos grow out of your entries and sink into history once done — no second checklist app.

3b.zh: 按你选的模板把这一周组织成稿，直接拿去发。
3b.en: Your template assembles the week into a draft you can send as is.

m4q.en: "What risk did the client raise last time?"

4b.zh: 从关键词到智能问答，四种找法按需开启；答案带着出处，点得回原文。
4b.en: Keyword through smart Q&A — four ways to look, enabled as you need them; answers cite their sources back to the original.

m5b.zh: 竞品动态 · 评审结论 · 客户回话
m5b.en: competitor news · review call · client reply

5b.zh: 结构化编辑器，写作时随手把你自己的资料摆到手边。
5b.en: A structured editor that keeps your own material within reach while you write.
